description: ML inference through ordinary science-mode operations; dedicated training on supplied data through the staged executor, each stage a governed plan step and a confined launch (R12).

specs.title: Apply a pinned published or supplied classifier
specs.description: A request on supplied events normally takes the study route, which admits the same operations. This spec serves a request whose intake names the published-classifier operation directly; requests naming another inference operation take the study or judgment route, so no plan runs a different operation than the one requested. It never contains training.

steps.title: Typed inference specification: classifier, features and population
Plan critique of the inference specification
Results with the classifier's scope and population fidelity

specs.title: Dedicated ML training on supplied data through the staged executor
specs.description: Typed stages, each a governed plan step and a confined launch: dataset admission and split, feature definition and the leakage screen (both before CHECK-IN 1), a training smoke as the waypoint, the full training launch after the CHECK-IN 2 GO (never given the withheld partition), one evaluation read of the withheld partition (an unblinding, with its own R3 authority), the model card and the executable reviewer items. A refused, held or budget-exhausted stage ends the run with a qualified delivery that states it.

steps.title: Staged training specification: dataset columns, features, split, arms, seeds, budget and check thresholds
Dataset admission and split with provenance
Feature definition and the label-leakage screen (training partition only)
Training smoke: one seed, few epochs, bounded rows (the waypoint before full training)
Training launch: every arm and seed within the approved budget, without the withheld partition
Evaluation: the one read of the withheld partition, after the models are frozen
Model card from the stage records
Executable reviewer items: leakage, split, duplicates, preprocessing scope, overtraining, budget, test custody and metrics
Study report bound to the model card, the evaluation and the review
